tagline: Photograph the care label. We read it, then check it against public records.

upload.drop: Drop photos of the label here
upload.hint: Up to {{max}} photos. Add the garment itself if you like.

progress.reading: Reading the label and checking the records…

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
errors.auth/email-already-in-use: An account already exists for that email. Sign in instead.
errors.auth/weak-password: Choose a password of at least 6 characters.
errors.auth/too-many-requests: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.auth/requires-recent-login: For security, sign out and back in before changing your password.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.delete: That scan could not be deleted. Try again.
errors.api/invalid-argument: Those photos could not be used. Send up to 4 JPEG, PNG or WebP images of at most 8 MB each.
errors.api/unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.api/internal: The label could not be read. Try again in a moment.

history.delete_confirm: Delete this scan and its photos? This cannot be undone.

result.unreadable: No label could be read in these photos. Take a sharper, closer photo of the composition label and try again.

environment.title: Environmental cost
environment.basis: Modelled by Ecobalyse for a typical {{mass}} g garment of this type. Lower is better.
environment.country_default: Ecobalyse does not model this country, so its default (worst case) was used for the making step.
environment.unsupported_garment: Ecobalyse does not model this type of garment.
environment.unsupported_fibre: One of these fibres is not in the Ecobalyse database.
environment.no_composition: A full composition is needed to model this garment.
environment.error: Ecobalyse could not be reached. Scan again later.

labour.caveat: The list covers countries and goods, not this factory or brand.
labour.unknown: Needs the country of origin, which is not on the label.
